dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Continuous, linear reduction in lateral width from the mid-body toward the posterior terminus.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white in the anterior section; transitions to a light-grey baseline in the posterior half.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Localized, diffuse clusters of medium-grey pigmentation on the mid-to-posterior dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse, low-gradient transition between the white anterior and grey-mottled posterior regions.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Single, high-contrast dark oval feature with a central reddish-pink region located on the dorsal midline.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Distinct longitudinal groove visible along the central dorsal axis of the posterior body.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent dark-rimmed lesion or puncture is visible on the dorsal midline posterior to the blowhole area.
other_distinctive_markers: Open blowhole showing internal reddish tissue; visible water surface ripples surrounding the anterior profile.
